check.claim: The mpeg_card.bin image Yabause hands to the Saturn BIOS through the Get MPEG ROM command (0xE2) changes what the BIOS shows and does for a Video CD.
check.method: Experimental build, not what RetroArch users run: libretro Yabause with yinit.mpegpath pointed at the system directory, which reaches the same cs2.c Cs2GetMPEGRom path that standalone Yabause uses when its MpegROM/Path setting is filled. Saturn BIOS v1.01 (Japan), one emulation thread, host clock frozen at 2000-01-01 00:00:00 by libfaketime 0.9.10 so runs are deterministic, the authored Video CD inserted. 3000 frames; the button the core maps to Saturn A held 15 frames from frame 1300 (Play on the BIOS CD player) and Start 15 frames from frame 1900. Repeated with each mpeg_card.bin image, with no file, with 512 KiB of zeros and with a 1-byte file; every other input is identical. Each variant runs twice in fresh processes.

result.statement: video_sha1 is identical across all 11 variants

core.build_command: make -j8 in yabause/src/libretro, after setting yinit.mpegpath to <system>/mpeg_card.bin in libretro.c (the port sets it to NULL)
